name: Gunung Lingkas

queries.query: Gunung Lingkas Indonesia official cadastral parcel map cadastre GIS Tarakan
queries.result: Found the official Tarakan open-data land-map record, official Tarakan district listing, and national ATR/BPN BHUMI map leads. No public Gunung Lingkas parcel geometry endpoint was established.

queries.query: Gunung Lingkas Indonesia peta bidang tanah resmi kadaster GIS tanah Tarakan
queries.result: Official Indonesian-language results identify Kelurahan Gunung Lingkas in Tarakan Timur and a Tarakan municipal Peta Bidang Tanah dataset produced by Dinas Perumahan, Kawasan Pemukiman dan Pertanahan. No downloadable parcel geometry or safe native parcel-ID response was exposed.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Kota Tarakan open-data portal; Dinas Perumahan, Kawasan Pemukiman dan Pertanahan
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official record named PETA BIDANG TANAH / Peta Bidang Tanah, unit Dokumen. Metadata names the municipal land/housing agency as producer. Year cells and download content were empty; no parcel geometry or stable parcel ID was exposed.
Official page documents GET catalog/search routes. Search for Peta Bidang Tanah returned the official record at /data/detil/959, not a machine-readable parcel layer.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Pemerintah Kota Tarakan / Tarakan Timur district portal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page identifies Kelurahan Gunung Lingkas, Tarakan Timur, its address and local contact. It is not cadastral geometry coverage.

Official BHUMI landing page and embedded public console were reachable anonymously. The inspected HTML/JavaScript exposed a viewer application but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response for the WUP point; no credentials or private fields were requested.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Badan Pusat Statistik / Kantor Pertanahan Kota Tarakan cited source
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official statistical publication records Gunung Lingkas and cites Kantor Pertanahan Kota Tarakan as source for area data. It is not a parcel geometry service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Peta Bidang Tanah metadata page loaded; producer and document unit recorded, but no file or geometry was present.
Returned the official record /data/detil/959; no parcel API or geometry response.
Official Tarakan Timur administrative page loaded and explicitly listed Kelurahan Gunung Lingkas.
Official BHUMI shell loaded and pointed to the public konsolbhumi.atrbpn.go.id viewer.

Public viewer shell and current JavaScript/configuration entrypoint were inspected. No bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained; no UI login bypass or unsafe query was attempted.
Historical official statistical publication inspected for local land-office provenance; no parcel geometry requested or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Tarakan municipal Peta Bidang Tanah is officially catalogued and a local land-data producer is identified, but current open parcel geometry coverage for Gunung Lingkas is not verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly exposed
blocker: No safe anonymous Gunung Lingkas parcel response containing a stable native ID and geometry was verified. The official local record is metadata-only and the national viewer did not yield a bounded response.
remainingUncertainty: The Tarakan land map may be maintained as a document, restricted layer, or interactive workflow not exposed by the catalog page. No exact-point hit or UI limitation is treated as evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Retry only if the Tarakan municipal portal publishes a parcel document/layer or a current public ATR/BPN route yields a safe native-ID-plus-geometry response; qualify any adapter independently before runtime use.
